title: Plan of Alloa, the seat of the Lord Mar
sourceInstitution: National Records of Scotland / University of Edinburgh
rightsStatement: Courtesy of the Keeper of the Records of Scotland
nextActions: Obtain written confirmation of image and derived-data reuse terms.
Acquire an authorised source image for local processing; do not commit it to the repository until the licence permits this.
Record at least four independently checked, stable ground-control points in WGS84.
Create a validated historic-town footprint or street-corridor GeoJSON, retaining this source record and a low confidence level until a second source corroborates it.
Only then create a production georeferencing manifest and run npm run check-georeference.
notes: The map is an especially valuable early-eighteenth-century source because the catalogue describes the town, harbour, old and new roads and streets. It must not be used as if it were a modern surveyed GIS layer.
